body:
Add `--ticket <id>` to `packages/model-router/bin/model-router.mjs` and `runRouter()` in `packages/model-router/lib/router.mjs` so P2 coldstart can route a single ticket without failing on unrelated under-railed tickets in the store.

Acceptance criteria:
1. `adlc model-router --ticket <id>` and `adlc model-router --ticket <id> --json` compute critical-path float over the active ticket DAG, then filter `assignments` and `p3Findings` to only `<id>`, exiting `0` when `<id>` has rails and `2` when `<id>` is under-railed. Verify: `node --test packages/model-router/test/model-router.test.mjs`
2. Passing `--ticket <unknown>` (or an empty/whitespace `--ticket`) exits `1` with an operator error on stderr. Verify: `node --test packages/model-router/test/model-router.test.mjs`
title: Scope adlc model-router to a single ticket when --ticket <id> is supplied (#1238)
